_doc: Classification of the negative-claim inventory (preview/m63_g0_negative_claims.json). First matching rule wins. basis = filing evidence checked at G0 (1-based PDF pages); 'keyword' = term searched in the filing text only (topic present/absent, content not read). Classes: CONTRADICTED (filing page discloses what the surface calls missing); PARTIAL (filing discloses part); KEYWORD_PRESENT (filing contains the topic, content unread); GENUINE_GAP_KEYWORD (term absent from the filing); METHOD (statement about method/verification, not a disclosure claim); REPOSITORY (true of the repository, e.g. file not held); OUT_OF_SCOPE (needs data that is not a filing item, or sector mis-frame); UI_LABEL; UNVERIFIED (not checked).
